name: Filament
description: Connects an OpenClaw agent to Filament: receives messages as Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) pushes — or, opt-in, through a poll_work long-poll — and replies through Filament's MCP-over-HTTP agents API.

transport.description: How work reaches the account. fcm (default): Firebase Cloud Messaging pushes, what production Filament serves. poll: the poll_work long-poll, which needs a synapse carrying ENG-1392.

firebase.description: The Firebase project an fcm account registers with; it must be the one the homeserver sends through. Each field defaults to FILAMENT_FIREBASE_* and then to production.

connectToken.description: Connect token (fmcp_…) of the single-agent install — the `default` account. A raw string, a ${ENV_VAR} shorthand, or a SecretRef. For more than one Filament agent on this gateway, use `accounts` instead.

accounts.description: One entry per Filament agent on this gateway, keyed by channel account id. Route each account to an OpenClaw agent with a binding: {agentId, match: {channel: "filament", accountId}}.

connectToken.description: This agent's Filament connect token (fmcp_…), a ${ENV_VAR} shorthand, or a SecretRef.

mcpUrl.description: Overrides the top-level mcpUrl for this account.

control.description: A gateway control account (install.sh OPENCLAW_GATEWAY=1): runs no agent turns, reports this gateway's agents to Filament and takes connect commands from its principal.

transport.description: Overrides the top-level transport for this account.

mcpUrl.description: Filament MCP agents endpoint (defaults to production; set for staging/local).

pollWaitSeconds.description: How long (seconds) each poll_work long-poll blocks server-side waiting for work (default 30, matching the server default; clamped to 1-60, the server's own max). Kept at or below 60 so an intermediary with a ~60s timeout (e.g. an nginx dev proxy) doesn't cut the connection before the server's own wait completes.
